new_value: Resolved with spec grounding (draft-lichen-link-01 section 3.1) rather than leaving as a policy question: (1) 'a PLD using a currently defined dispatch value MUST be at least 2 bytes' — a lone 0x14 (like the lone 0x15 fixed in 1pf8) violates that MUST and was still reaching the app callback as UNKNOWN; now dropped. (2) 'link framing permits an empty PLD' — a syntactic allowance, not semantic: delivering b'' to the application was spurious (no keep-alive/no-op semantics exist); now dropped. (3) Undefined dispatch values remain the application extension point — documented in the code comment with the spec section, retained deliberately for authenticated bounded inputs. Tests: 2 new (empty + truncated 0x14 + truncated 0x15 all dropped; undefined 0x99 still delivered pinning the extension point); node suite 140 passed; ruff clean. 3x review (kimi-k3): correctness PASS (spec citation verified exact at lines 119-121; cosmetic note on now-always-true bool(payload) left untouched), security PASS (empty PLD spurious delivery removed; lone 0x14 cannot be SCHC per rule-ID requirement; extension-point surface = authenticated peers + bounded frames only), edge PASS (0x78/0x79 single-byte fragment bytes unaffected; 0x15 arm harmless defensive redundancy; logger args match).
